chunks: And severed their Scripture into fragments.

key_terms.عِضِينَ: Fragments, pieces, or sects (plural of عَضْوٌ, meaning limb or part)

ai.seo_question: What does it mean to make the Quran into 'chunks' or fragments?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse critiques those who fragment the Quran into disjointed 'parts' (aḍʿān) to support specific theological or legal positions while ignoring contradictory verses, a practice often associated with early sects like the Khawarij or Mu'tazila. This selective interpretation leads to a loss of the text's holistic coherence (munāsabat), undermining the unity of divine guidance.
